notes: s016 τῷ is emptied by the possessive and, having no determiner to anchor it, does not carry *to*, which stays with πατρί under rule 21's determinerless clause.
s019 (verbless prepositional modifier) keeps the relativizer, while s027 (participial modifier of an expressed noun) does not — rule 31 divides them on exactly that test.
ταμεῖόν → *inner chamber* heads on *chamber*, the word glossing the lexeme (rule 66).
